title: The customer card shows a Pricing section under IBS, in order
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'View and Manage AP/AR Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a tax set up for this test in Settings, tax A, named for example GST 5%.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders and tier B for Part Sales, with Default Shop Supplies set to No shop supplies and tax A picked.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Below IBS the card shows a section headed Pricing, with no edit boxes.
  • The rows read, in order: Labor Rate, Shop Supplies reading "No shop supplies", Tax, Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier.
  • Tax reads tax A's name as it is written in Settings.
  • Work Order Tier reads tier A's number and name; Part Sales Tier reads tier B's number and name.

AUTOMATION: Not available on Build to test Yet - Last checked 11/14/2026
